answer_prose: Sections marked uphill, downhill or near level in the supplied course profiles have different observed pacing patterns. This is an exploratory alignment with a route proxy.
detail_prose: The route files mostly describe recent editions. Their historical validity is unverified, so this cannot measure the effect of the hills actually run in every year.
